remarks: Enjoy easy living in this beautifully renovated second-floor 2-bedroom rental, ideally located in the heart of Westport. Fresh, modern and completely updated throughout, this apartment offers a bright living room, two generously sized bedrooms, and a stylish new full bath, with convenient washer and dryer. A private balcony provides the perfect spot to unwind, while ample off-street parking is available. Set directly across from the scenic Saugatuck River, the location makes it easy to enjoy everything Westport has to offer: shops, restaurants and the train station are all just minutes away. Thoughtfully renovated from top to bottom, this inviting home offers the comfort and feel of a brand-new space in an exceptionally convenient Westport setting. Available furnished or unfurnished for immediate occupancy. The 2-bedroom unit downstairs is also available. All applicants to come through RentSpree, excellent credit a must. ALL UTILITIES INCLUDED
